verdict.rationale: Unity's docs confirm a 3D engine with rendering, lighting, and visual-effects capabilities ('latest advances in rendering, lighting, and visual effects', high-end 3D games, real-time 3D graphics), but they never name the specific renderer features the story asks for. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of PBR materials, global illumination or baked lightmapping, shadow systems, post-processing, render pipeline documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of rendering quality.
